integrity.computational_tests: exhaustive within explicitly stated finite ranges, not a replacement for proof

scientific_limitations: The relative idempotent-commutant counts do not determine full element-centralizers.
All asymptotic estimates fix the number of selected idempotents.
The one-idempotent numerical specialization and its asymptotic are already present in OEIS A225887; the Narayana and colored-path machinery is classical.
An equivalent formula for the multivariate specialization may appear elsewhere under weighted lattice-path terminology; global publication priority is not certified.
title: Simultaneous idempotent commutants of \(i\)-Catalan monoids and a golden-ratio singularity transition
